They can be. But they can also allow a person to get an education when they would have otherwise never been able to afford it. You just have to be reasonable about the amount of debt you take on versus the earning potential of the degree you're after. 100k in debt isn't that bad if you're making a 6 figure salary staring out. But for a liberal arts degree that will get you 30k max in the first year out of school? Not so smart.

I'd say a good rule of thumb is to not take out any more debt than what you can earn gross in the first year out of school. Since student loans are on a 10 year repayment schedule it means that loan payments should never be much more than 10% of gross salary. And less as your salary increases.
